inputs.description: The user's actually supplied rice-field railway photograph; inspect it before editing. Example filename is not an attached image.

frame.treatment: Continuous even flat golden-yellow frame, no bevel or shadow

factual_anchors: Actual defining railway direction and curve
Actual rice fields and mountain silhouette
Original identity and known subjects of the target photograph
allowed_changes: Approved art-derived reframing and tonal separation
Integrated typography and controlled foreground rice layering
forbidden_changes: Famous landmarks, vehicles, recognizable people, temples or new named locations
Unrequested price, barcode, issue or official masthead
review_checks: One immediate visual focus at 200px wide
Exact Chinese characters and intended line order
Source image retains tangible photographic depth/material
Masthead and headline have different functions and strong local contrast
No accidental collision of text and important subject features
content_promise: 稻田、轨道与村镇的关系在内页得到解释；示范基于实际照片的受控艺术封面。

direction.why_this_image: The actual curved railway leads from lower left into the horizon, while rice on the right offers a coherent title field.
direction.rejected_route: centered postcard with title on a separate panel
direction.why_rejected: It would hide the railway's curve and detach the topic from the scene.

art_direction.subject: The supplied Dali field photograph, keeping its defining railway and geographical cues.
art_direction.camera: Reframe from the supplied image's actual viewpoint; no invented drone or reversed railway.
art_direction.subject_scale: Reduce excess sky toward upper third if crop permits; keep sufficient quiet blue for original masthead.
art_direction.foreground: Golden rice on lower right; a few real-looking rice tips overlap the lowest title edges.
art_direction.middle_ground: Railway enters from lower left, curves toward horizon and stays visible through the title composition.
art_direction.background: Preserve the actual mountain silhouette, existing distant settlement and daylight identity.
art_direction.eye_path: Masthead in sky -> railway from lower left -> field title on right -> mountain horizon.
art_direction.light: Natural daylight enhanced with controlled separation, no fabricated event.
art_direction.palette: Deep jade green, warm rice gold and mineral blue; warm ivory display lettering.
art_direction.texture: Photographic rice, soil and rail texture with credible daylight, no plastic HDR.

text.font_character: Large white Song serif, independent original publication masthead.
text.contrast_plan: Calm blue sky, avoid clouds behind fine strokes.
Clear sky of sufficient dark/blue tone.

text.font_character: Small semantic location line, clear medium serif.
text.contrast_plan: Place over a locally dark/green field area.

text.font_character: Very large warm ivory Chinese Song serif, confident strokes and full glyphs.
text.contrast_plan: Right field dark enough across the entire characters; railway unobstructed.

occlusion.foreground: Only a few foreground rice tips across the lowest edges.
occlusion.protected_features: Keep all radicals, character interiors and line order readable.

text.font_character: Small semantic serif English subtitle, accurately spelled.
text.contrast_plan: Dark continuous field area, not bright rice heads.
